subject.title: Support installing all skills/plugins from a publisher

question: Should ClawHub support publisher-wide bulk installs, and should that mean every public item or an explicit publisher-curated bundle?
rationale: The current install surfaces are item-scoped, and this changes trust, safety, compatibility, pagination, and command semantics rather than fixing a defined bug.

options.title: Require curated bundles first
options.body: Publishers define an explicit install set or bundle manifest, avoiding blind installation of every current listing.

options.title: Install all eligible items
options.body: The CLI installs every public non-blocked skill/plugin for a publisher with prompts and per-item safety gates.

options.title: Keep discovery item-scoped
options.body: Publisher pages and searches remain discovery surfaces while install stays one item at a time.

recommendation.title: Require curated bundles first
recommendation.body: Publishers define an explicit install set or bundle manifest, avoiding blind installation of every current listing.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick authored the request and is tied by blame/history to the current CLI command surface.
